comment: v2.33.0 shared parser fixtures. Consumed by test_js/run_prompt_fixtures.js (engine/promptParser.js) and test/fs_parser_test.dart (lib/services/prompt_parser.dart). Both suites must produce EXACTLY these items: label = the label as written (null when none), text = the prompt text exactly as the engine submits it (label lines stay in the text for line-based formats).

A calm valley at dawn with mist lifting off the river
